gateDefinitions.services: Selected service pipeline: build, types/static checks and full unit/integration suites.
gateDefinitions.contracts: Provider API First suites and live security-to-commercial producer/consumer tests.
gateDefinitions.smoke: Tagged container health, private route 401, non-root user, port isolation and cleanup.
gateDefinitions.security: Pinned dependency and secret scans; no unreviewed findings.
gateDefinitions.branch-review: GitHub required PR approval, stale-review dismissal and resolved conversations; semantic criteria require reviewer evidence.
gateDefinitions.week14-required: Always-emitted fail-closed aggregate for all applicable jobs.
gateDefinitions.system-tests: Week 15 real-container integration, two cash monetary backend E2Es, published-response contracts, scoped k6 probe and isolated stop/restart recovery. Full Phase 1 workload remains subject to review.

items.criterion: Each service writes only in its own domain schema and connects with its domain user `<domain>_app`, never with the administrator (Annex J.2, J.3.2). Cross-domain data comes through events or the owner's published API; a read-only `SELECT` on another domain's tables is accepted only with a `GRANT` from the owner's `-db` and an ADR recording it as technical debt (Annex J.3.3). This project does not use that option, so a service never reads another domain's tables (ADR-005 E7). No foreign keys across domain schemas (Annex J.3.4)
items.reviewEvidence: Reviewer checks applicability and the story-specific evidence; missing applicable evidence blocks approval.
